description: This Java source file defines an abstract class CommonCredential that encapsulates common properties and behaviors for various credential types in the Hono project, including JSON serialization annotations, getter/setter methods, and validation logic.

classes.name: CommonCredential
classes.description: Abstract class representing common credential properties and behaviors used across different credential implementations in Hono, with support for JSON serialization, extension properties, and validation.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Abstract method returning a list of the secrets associated with this credential.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Returns the authentication identifier used for device authentication.

methods.name: setAuthId
methods.description: Sets the authentication identifier and returns the current instance for method chaining.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether this credential is enabled for device authentication.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether the credential is enabled and returns the current instance.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the human-readable comment describing the credential.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment and returns the current instance.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns the map of extension properties associated with this credential.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Sets the extension properties map and returns the current instance.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces an extension key-value pair in the extensions map.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates the credential, throwing an exception if the auth ID is missing or invalid.
